[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Make a Permutation!** [CF 864D · Make a Permutation!](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/864/D){rating="1500"}

Give every value its home slot, as in cyclic sort. A value that appears $c > 1$ times has $c - 1$ *spare* copies, and a value that never appears leaves a *gap*; spares and gaps are equal in number, so $q$ is the number of gaps. For the smallest result, walk left to right and also overwrite a *first* copy of $v$ when a smaller gap is waiting and another copy of $v$ is still to come.

[Solved in full in @sec-idx-p1-makeperm.]{.card-link}

:::
